title: Security architecture approval delay
description: Security review has not been completed and could delay migration activities.

title: Legacy dependency compatibility
description: A legacy integration may not be fully compatible with the target cloud environment.

title: Partner authentication migration
description: Some external partners may not complete authentication updates before the legacy interface is retired.

title: Critical remediation backlog
description: Several high-priority security findings remain unresolved near the target completion date.

title: Limited engineering capacity
description: Engineering resources are shared with other security initiatives, creating schedule pressure.

title: Incomplete source system documentation
description: Documentation for several acquired applications is incomplete, increasing integration uncertainty.

title: Data mapping complexity
description: Differences in source and target data models may require additional transformation work.

title: Third-party vendor upgrade dependency
description: A vendor patch is required before migration testing can begin.

title: AI response accuracy
description: Generated support summaries may omit or misinterpret operational details.

title: Sensitive data exposure
description: Operational incident data may contain information that should not be exposed to the AI model.

title: Support team adoption
description: Support engineers may be slow to adopt the new AI-assisted workflow.
